ModMetaData.name: Homesteader
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
Everything a growing homestead needs: tribal survival, farm-to-table crafting, storage, food preservation, and off-grid power.
TRIBAL SURVIVAL (no research) - Drying rack: jerky, dried produce, fruit leather, dried mushrooms, and pemmican without needing pemmican research. - Curing rack: rock salt from stone chunks, salted meat. - Smokehouse: wood-fired smoked meat that still cooks into meals. - Hayloft, ingredient barrel, and all original storage options.
FARM-TO-TABLE - Grain mill and butter churn for flour and butter. - Pickling crock and homestead hearth for pickled vegetables, bread, hardtack, trail stew, and hearty stew.
RESEARCH & PROGRESSION - Primitive homestead, food preservation, farmstead crafting, homestead storage, and advanced homestead research projects. - Root cellar, large storage crate, jam cauldron, and wood-burning generator.
POWER - Compact battery, battery bank, advanced battery, ultratech battery, portable chemfuel generator.
Odyssey owners get salted and smoked fish recipes automatically.
Fully XML-based: no C# assembly, safe to add or remove from a save (remove mod items from the map first before uninstalling).
